stories.title: Cheshire Police among seven forces inspected over facial recognition searches
stories.summary: Police forces are searching custody photographs that should have been deleted when they use facial recognition to identify suspects, a national inspection has found. stories.title: Connah’s Quay’s Andy Dunbobbin elected chair of Police Digital Service board
stories.summary: North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin, from Connah’s Quay, has been elected chair of the board of the Police Digital Service. stories.title: “Extreme recklessness”: Flintshire councillors face vote to condemn their own colleagues
stories.summary: Flintshire councillors will be asked to condemn colleagues who changed the council’s call-in rules last month, in a motion claiming the new process is incompatible with the law. stories.title: Minister wants to ‘tackle pavement parking’ as Wales lags behind UK
stories.summary: Wales’ transport minister has said pavement parking is probably the biggest single thing Senedd Members have written to him about, and that Wales is “lagging behind” some other UK countries on it. stories.title: Flintshire Bridge due once-a-decade cable inspection, with £1.3m set aside for checks
stories.summary: Flintshire Bridge is due its once-a-decade cable inspection, and Flintshire Council has set aside £1.3m for it and the repairs expected to follow.
